original_evidence.shared: A and B are adult partners. B spent twenty minutes alone in another room after arriving home. They had no explicit agreement about greetings.
original_evidence.A: I felt rejected when B went to the other room. I thought B was angry with me.
original_evidence.B: I felt overloaded by the noise at work. I wanted a quiet interval so I took a few minutes so I could be more present when I came out.

original_evidence.shared: A and B are adult partners. During an argument A said, "I want to leave the room now." B stood in the only doorway and refused to move for five minutes. A could not leave during those five minutes.
original_evidence.A: I felt afraid when I could not leave. I wanted space. I did not agree to stay in the room.
original_evidence.B: I felt panicked about the argument ending unfinished. I wanted to finish talking. I stood in the doorway after A asked me to move.
